english: Consider $f(x)=\sqrt{-\tan x}+\log_e\left(4\pi^2-x^2\right)$. Let $D$ be the set of all real numbers $x$ for which $f(x)$ is defined, and let $S=\{x\in D:\ \sin2x+\sin x=0\}$. If the sum of all elements of $S$ is $\dfrac{k\pi}{3}$, then the value of $k$ is ______.
hindi: $f(x)=\sqrt{-\tan x}+\log_e\left(4\pi^2-x^2\right)$ पर विचार कीजिए। माना कि $D$ उन सभी वास्तविक संख्याओं $x$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए $f(x)$ परिभाषित है, तथा $S=\{x\in D:\ \sin2x+\sin x=0\}$ है। यदि $S$ के सभी अवयवों का योग $\dfrac{k\pi}{3}$ है, तो $k$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $\sin2x+\sin x=\sin x(2\cos x+1)=0\Rightarrow\sin x=0$ or $\cos x=-\frac12$
$\sin x=0$ in $(-2\pi,2\pi)$: $-\pi,0,\pi$, all with $\tan x=0\le0$, so all in $S$ ($\pm2\pi$ excluded by the log)
solution_full: Domain of $f$: the logarithm needs $4\pi^2-x^2>0$, i.e. $-2\pi<x<2\pi$. The root needs $\tan x$ to be defined ($x\ne\frac{\pi}{2}+n\pi$) and $-\tan x\ge0$, i.e. $\tan x\le0$.
So $D=\{x\in(-2\pi,2\pi):\ \tan x\le0\}$; note that points with $\tan x=0$ are included.
The equation: $\sin2x+\sin x=2\sin x\cos x+\sin x=\sin x\,(2\cos x+1)=0$.
Case $\sin x=0$: in $(-2\pi,2\pi)$, $x=-\pi,0,\pi$ (the points $\pm2\pi$ are outside $D$ because of the logarithm). At each, $\tan x=0$, so $\sqrt{-\tan x}=0$ is defined. All three are in $S$.
originality_note: New: the domain of a function built from sqrt(-tan x) and log(4pi^2 - x^2) acts as a filter on the roots of sin 2x + sin x = 0; the root sign test keeps tan x = 0 points but only two of the four cos x = -1/2 points, and the log removes +-2pi (way 5). Closest known: 'domain of sqrt(-tan x)' or 'solve sin 2x + sin x = 0 in [0, 2pi]' as separate exercises. Different because: the solutions are filtered by a function's domain and the asymmetric survivors give a nonzero sum.
blueprint_concepts: Domain restrictions from log, root and denominator; rejecting solutions
Domain of algebraic, logarithmic, exponential and radical functions

concept_use.Domain restrictions from log, root and d: The roots of sin x (2 cos x + 1) = 0 are tested against tan x <= 0 and |x| < 2pi; x = +-2pi, -2pi/3 and 4pi/3 are rejected.
concept_use.Domain of algebraic, logarithmic, expone: The domain D of f is found from the radical sqrt(-tan x) (tan x <= 0, tan defined) and the logarithm log(4pi^2 - x^2) (|x| < 2pi).

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, function and interval is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical scan), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Avoided calling f a function with an unstated domain: D is defined as the set where f(x) is defined. Checked that tan x = 0 points belong to D (square root of 0). Changed: No change.
key_step: Applying the domain filter tan x <= 0, |x| < 2pi to each root of sin x (2 cos x + 1) = 0, keeping the tan x = 0 roots.
justification: Two ideas linked (domain of a radical-plus-log function and filtering roots of a trig equation) with several traps (+-2pi, tan x = 0, quadrant signs). Comparable to 2023-P2-Q3 (L3).
